question: Which of the following entities is NOT a sexually transmitted disease caused by Chlamydia trachomatis?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Perihepatitis" -> "inflammation of liver capsule" -> "associated with Chlamydia trachomatis" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Urethritis" -> "inflammation of urethra" -> "commonly caused by Chlamydia trachomatis" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Chancroid" -> "caused by Haemophilus ducreyi" -> "not caused by Chlamydia trachomatis" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Lymphogranuloma venereum" -> "caused by Chlamydia trachomatis" -> "infection of lymphatic system" -> 90%
analysis: Chlamydia trachomatis is a bacterium that causes several sexually transmitted diseases, including urethritis, perihepatitis (Fitz-Hugh-Curtis syndrome), and lymphogranuloma venereum. However, chancroid is caused by a different bacterium, Haemophilus ducreyi, and is not associated with Chlamydia trachomatis.
